campaign: Executable tightening: typed storage, device catalogs, and shared execution
doctrine: Deletion-led waves. Existing artifact codecs, tensor stores, recipe definitions, and mathematical operators remain authoritative. Move every production caller and delete displaced readers, dtype wrappers, validation walkers, and execution clones in the same commit. No compatibility aliases or fallback paths. Preserve numerical behavior. Each wave must be production-code net-negative and pass focused host tests, applicable CUDA lanes, plan verification, and the commit gate before merging tightening/master.

items.title: Use one converted CUDA weight catalog

steps.title: Parameterize converted residency by dtype and delete F32 and BF16 wrappers
steps.rationale: Converted tensors share allocation, loading, lookup, input binding, and lifetime ownership; dtype selects only storage conversion and graph input type.

steps.title: Replace duplicate graph identity walkers with one adjacent-key validator
steps.rationale: Canonical sorting already defines every identity key; duplicate detection should consume those keys once.

steps.title: Use one host forward and backward pass across optimizer lanes
steps.rationale: Host and host-master lanes execute identical forward, trace, backward, packing, and scratch reuse; optimizer ownership remains lane-specific.
